verificationTarget: Editor records a bounded Overview, History, and Structure UX design plus implementation plan that separates Project Control Overview/History from Editor Structure, classifies ambiguous terms, and stops before UI implementation pending user review.
summary: Done: Editor merge commit 16b9ba43d42a2a2beebeca48caeb96d533101dac adds a bounded Overview, History, and Structure UX planning gate. The spec defines Project Control Repo Directory Overview, Project Control Work History View, Editor Structure Panel, and Editor local history, and classifies Overview, History, Structure, Work, Evidence, Map, Node, Phase, and Readiness using the canonical FlowDoc ambiguity dispositions. The implementation plan gives future tasks for surface vocabulary, Structure selection path facts, Project Control cross-link contracts, and a user review gate. This does not implement Project Control Overview or Work History UI, does not change Editor Structure UI, does not enable WYSIWYG behavior or contenteditable runtime, and does not promote product or map truth.
